A US State Department file records that President Tsao Kun pursued a policy of conciliating rival faction leaders.

body.en: The gazette records that Du Yuming was appointed Northeast Security Commander in October 1945, Deputy Commander-in-Chief of the Xuzhou bandit-suppression headquarters in August 1948, and in November 1948 Deputy Commander-in-Chief of the Northeast headquarters. A Guang’an Daily article says that in the third phase of the Huaihai Campaign in December 1948 Du and Qiu Qingquan broke out of Xuzhou and were encircled at Chenguanzhuang, and that on 6 January 1949 the PLA launched its final assault and captured Du.

body.zh-Hant: 公報記，毛邦初於1951年8月因失職抗命被免空軍副總司令；中研院臺灣史研究所年表亦記，同日蔣介石下令駐美空軍副總司令毛邦初停職處分。中央社介紹小說《1951全面追緝》時稱，毛邦初以空軍副總司令職銜派駐華府擔任空軍駐美辦事處主任，後在美國揭露軍購密帳而引發「毛邦初案」。
body.en: The gazette records that Mao was dismissed as deputy commander-in-chief of the air force in August 1951 for dereliction and disobedience, and the Academia Sinica Taiwan history chronology likewise notes that on the same day Chiang Kai-shek ordered the suspension of Mao, air force deputy commander in the United States. Introducing the novel 1951 Full Pursuit, CNA says Mao was posted to Washington with the title of air force deputy commander as head of the air force office there, and exposed secret arms-procurement accounts, triggering the "Mao Bangchu case".

body.en: According to an article from Jinan Cultural and Historical Materials republished by the Nanjing Folk Anti-Japanese War Museum, Shen Honglie was born in 1882, went to study in Japan in 1906, and during the 1911 Revolution was ordered by Li Yuanhong to induce the Yangtze river flotilla to defect; he was later appointed river-defence commander and head of the aviation and navigation office by Zhang Zuolin, and then commander of the Northeast fleet. The gazette records that in July 1933 he asked to resign as Northeast fleet commander.

body.zh-Hant: 該文記，1939年6月日偽軍八萬人掃蕩魯南山區，對當地抗日武裝的進攻持續了半個多月，沈鴻烈曾陷入包圍而脫險。公報記，他於1941年12月特任農林部部長，1942年1月免山東省政府主席，2月免保安司令。該文另稱他戰後出任浙江省主席，只有兩年，後調考試院銓敘部部長。
body.en: The article says that in June 1939 Japanese and puppet forces of 80,000 swept the southern Shandong mountains, an offensive against the local anti-Japanese forces lasting more than half a month, and that Shen was once surrounded but escaped. The gazette records his appointment as Minister of Agriculture and Forestry in December 1941 and his release as Shandong chairman in January 1942 and as security commander in February. The article adds that after the war he served as Zhejiang chairman for only two years before moving to head the Examination Yuan’s Ministry of Personnel.
